description: Feature: i18n source-template selection (PR1) + fix Codex config.toml multi_agent_v2 block.
changelog:
**Enhancements:**
- feat(cli): `trellis init` and `trellis update` accept `--language <code>` (one-shot override) and read `language: en|zh` from `.trellis/config.yaml`. Priority: flag > `TRELLIS_LANGUAGE` env > `config.yaml` > `en` (default).
- feat(templates): source layer now selects `workflow.<locale>.md` when present and falls back to English. Landed file is always `.trellis/workflow.md`; `.template-hashes.json` keys remain locale-agnostic.
- feat(scripts): new `common/i18n.py` (`set_locale` / `t(key)`) backed by `i18n_strings/{en,zh}.py` dictionaries. `init_developer.py` migrated as the pilot; remaining scripts follow in PR2/PR3.
- feat(scripts): new `get_language()` accessor in `common/config.py` reads the new `language:` field with warn-on-invalid fallback to `en`.

**Bug Fixes:**
- fix(codex): `trellis init` / `trellis update` no longer write a `[features.multi_agent_v2]` block to `.codex/config.toml`. Codex CLI changed `features` deserialization between 0.130 and 0.131; the structured table form is only accepted by 0.131+. On 0.130 and earlier — including the Codex CLI bundled in the Codex desktop app — it failed with `data did not match any variant of untagged enum FeatureToml in features.multi_agent_v2`, aborting the entire config load and blocking Codex from starting.
notes: Patch on top of 0.5.18. Run `trellis update` to: (1) materialize the new `language:` section in `.trellis/config.yaml` (commented-out by default — zero behavior change); (2) regenerate `.codex/config.toml` without the multi_agent_v2 block.
